CFML Language Reference: Functions

IsK2ServerOnline

Returns YES when the Verity K2 Server is running and can answer searches. The server can be stopped and started on the Administrator's Verity page.

Category

System functions

Syntax

IsK2ServerOnline()

Returns

YES or NO.

Usage

Note  This function came to CFML two major versions after 4.5, with later Verity K2 support; KoldFusion provides it so pages written for it run here too.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFIF IsK2ServerOnline()>
  <CFOUTPUT><P>The K2 Server is online with #ListLen(GetK2ServerCollections())# collection(s).</P></CFOUTPUT>
<CFELSE>
  <P>The K2 Server is offline; searches will fail.</P>
</CFIF>

See also

IsK2ServerABroker, GetK2ServerCollections, CFSEARCH
